reviews.text: Working with Texas State Fence was easy and stress-free. Their quote was competitive, communication was prompt, and they started sooner than I expected. The final wood fence + stain looks great and really adds to the curb appeal. Excellent value for money.

Texas State Fence Company exceeded my expectations from the first consultation to the final installation, their team was professional, courteous, and punctual. The new cedar fence looks beautiful and sturdy. The 10-year structural warranty gave me confidence. Highly recommend them for any fencing or gate work.

I needed a custom driveway gate and electric gate setup, and Texas State Fence delivered. Their weld-iron gate is solid, installation was quick, and the crew cleaned up after themselves. Great craftsmanship and smooth process — very happy with the result!

We had some damage from storms and needed repairs plus re-staining. Texas State Fence came through: they responded fast, fixed the broken sections properly, matched the stain to our house, and made the fence look brand new. The team’s attention to detail and care for our property was impressive.

Great experience all around. Patrick was very patient explaining the pricing and process. Also very patient with the multiple revisions of the bid. He didnt try to up sale or talk to me into one size over the other.  We went with the 8ft board on board and couldn't be more pleased. Tony and his help went above and beyond. Knocked it out and cleaned up afterwards.

I got at least 5 quotes from different individuals or fencing companies before I decided to go with Texas State Fence Company.  They went above and beyond to provide us the best deal possible.  Very trustworthy and amazing work.  Absolutely love the fence 100 percent recommend them.

I would not give my business to this company. Company owner does not pay his contractual obligations and destroyed our wall. Did not follow HOA rules and left a mess we had clean up. There is many honest contractors just not Jason or Patrick.
Seamless horizontal build of my dreams! The company covered the grass and furniture leaving no stain behind. Effective communication from owner and the results left me speechless.

Great job by Texas State Fence Company! They showed up on time, worked their butt's off, and did a fabulous job! I've had many neighbors compliment on how great the fence looks, and some have commented that they plan to use Texas State Fence. Jason was pleasant to work with, too. I highly recommend Texas State Fence.

The entire job was so professional; the scheduling, the workmanship, the attention to detail … The job involved replacing my fence that was severely damaged due to a storm.  The end result is a new fence with even greater curb appeal than my original wood fence.  And it’s better constructed, too.   I highly recommend Texas State Fence!

I can’t say enough how great this company is. I researched a few fencing companies before choosing them. I was given a quote a very fair one. I had had a minor issues (not related to their workmanship) and they came out and fixed them. I still get compliments on how great our fence looks.

Texas State Fence Company provided excellent service throughout the process.  I worked with Jason primarily, and his professionalism speaks for itself. I would recommend these guys to my grandmother because they treat you like family.
Second time using Texas State Fence and they did an awesome job! Jason was great at communicating and the job was done in less than 2 days. Very professional and top workmanship! Highly recommend!
We had the best experience working with the team at Texas state fence.
Great quality work and very professional. I would highly recommend them.
They were wonderful.  Communication, work on the fence, everything was fabulous.  I would highly recommend.
Did a great job on our 8ft horizontal cedar backyard fence build, I also have them re-stain it regularly
Does great work! Highly recommend.
They are the best at what they do!!! If you want a good quality fence 10/10 recommend!
Great customer service and beautiful imaginative work! Highly recommend!
